p2_b7.ocr: on day 28 was similar for both treatments (99.3 % versus 96.9 % for AA and AL, respectively; P >0.05). No child had early treatment failure, however, late parasitological failure (LPF) occurred in 16 children, who were all enrolled between 2005 and 2010. There was no significant difference in the proportions of children with LPF in the two treatment groups (8/120 children treated with AA versus 8/130 children treated with AL, P >0.05). The proportion of children with LPF was also similar in infants and non-infants, and was not in ≥2 years old malarious children according to study site
